about_the_game:
Welcome to Alley Cats Idle—a laid-back game all about building your very own bustling alley full of charming cats.

Start small with a curious stray or two, then sit back as your alley fills with a colorful cast of feline personalities. Each cat you collect brings its own style, antics, and upgrades to your growing urban hideaway.

🐾 Collect Cats – Unlock a wide variety of cats, from scrappy alley prowlers to fluffy cuddlebugs, each with unique looks and personalities.

🏙️ Upgrade Your Alley – Transform a quiet backstreet into a thriving cat paradise with cozy boxes, scratching posts, and hidden nooks.

😺 Idle & Relax – Earn rewards even while you’re away—your cats never stop exploring, playing, and napping.

🎨 Charming Style – Relax with cozy visuals and a lighthearted atmosphere perfect for cat lovers.

Whether you’re a casual player who enjoys checking in from time to time or someone who loves unlocking every collectible, Alley Cats Idle is a relaxing, feel-good experience about friendship, discovery, and of course… cats.
